_what: C-9 BV2F ARENA (R-C9-345/347/348): the KC2 wave fight brought to barrow_v2. Frame: barrow_v2 SIM (x, y) = (u, -v) (level.json sim._frame); the KC2 frame = barrow sim - fight_centre_sim (no rotation: +x screen-right, +y toward the camera in both). Read by scripts/arena/arena_session.gd (anchors) and arena_mode.gd (start, blockers).
fight_centre_rule: the player's start = KC2 (0,0). Placed ON the sea-cave stair's own line (foot + 14 m uphill along route.ramp dir_sim reversed) so the p03 line climbs the stair, on open snow/ash ground (11 of 795 half-metre cells in its 8 m disc steep or out of bounds)

p01.rule: beside the hull, 4.8 m off its north (inland) side, on the top of the bank (5.1 m from the hull centre): the gentlest straight line from the wreck to the fight centre (max slope 17 deg on the walk heightfield, no inner wall crossed); the hull's own ends sit in the basin under a 60-70 deg bank

p03.rule: the iced ledge at the stair's foot, 4.96 m east of the mouth centre (-1.2321, 11.7551): the only point by the mouth with a straight line to the fight area, and that line IS the stair (no pathing)

p05.rule: on the mere ice, its east lobe, nearest the fight; bodies rise out of the ice (the runtime's own p05 emergence window, the pack's emerge clip); no hazard

blockers.rule: the doorway, 0.8 m in (curtain) to 1.2 m out, door width 3.378 + 0.6
the doorway, 0.8 m in to 1.2 m out, door width 2.598 + 0.6
the mouth, 2.4 m in (curtain) to 1.0 m out, mouth width 6.0 + 0.6
the WRECK MODEL's footprint (level.json sim.models.wreck 13.0 x 4.63 m, at the hull probe's 32.471 deg) + 0.3 m a side (R-C9-353: was the 9.1 x 2.08 hull probe, smaller than the ship)
the breach probe (h_rect 4 x 4, rot 104.379) + 0.2 m a side

hazards: none: the six crucible floor pools are dropped (R-C9-348); doorways + wreck + gable are blockers instead; p05 needs none

walk_keepout.rule: R-C9-353: the wreck's basin (walk surface below -1.0 m within 14 m of the hull) is not floor for the player: the only ways down are banks he cannot climb back up
